rows.model_reason: Marine shrimp given a 15-day sublethal PVC microplastic pre-exposure, then a live Vibrio parahaemolyticus immersion challenge with 7-day survival; pollutant pre-exposure followed by a later challenge meets criteria 2-3 (outcome worsened). Cluster is other, not immune, because the priming stressor is the pollutant; the pathogen is only the later challenge.

rows.label: include
rows.title: Vibrio coralliilyticus BAA-450 sublethal priming (live or formalin-inactivated cells) then
rows.model_reason: Coral primed by chronic non-lethal live or inactivated Vibrio coralliilyticus exposure, then given a subsequent Vibrio infection under heat stress; primed corals showed less bleaching and better photosynthetic efficiency. All four criteria are met, and pathogen priming places it in the immune cluster (not coral).

rows.model_reason: No conditioning phase (criterion 2): selectively bred Acropora larvae given a single acute heat assay, with survival modelled against parental reef thermal history from satellite SST; this is a heritable-tolerance/provenance correlation with no applied priming exposure or common-garden conditioning contrast (cf. the selection-response gradients exclusion)

rows.label: include
rows.title: embryonic hypoxia (moderate and severe)
rows.model_reason: Haliotis discus hannai (gastropod) embryonic hypoxia exposure of F0 with F1 growth and hypoxia tolerance assessed years later; all four criteria met (extends Shen_2022 system to an intergenerational design)

rows.label: include
rows.title: elevated temperature (transient sublethal larval heat shock)
rows.model_reason: Nematostella vectensis larvae given a transient sublethal heat shock (1 h at 39 C), then juveniles assessed after >1 week of ambient recovery for size and heat tolerance (negative carryover); all four criteria hold, matching the Glass_2023 and Rivera_2021 Nematostella precedents

rows.model_reason: Ruditapes philippinarum orally primed with sublethal live Vibrio europaeus then given a lethal secondary challenge (87% vs 0% survival); all four criteria hold, matching Li_2025a/Li_2025b sublethal-Vibrio priming precedents

rows.label: include
rows.title: repeated sublethal hypoxia (hypoxic preconditioning, HP)
rows.model_reason: Pinctada fucata martensii given repeated sublethal hypoxic preconditioning, then a 15 d sustained hypoxic challenge compared with non-preconditioned controls; all four criteria met (priming-then-challenge design, criterion 2-3). Hypoxia stressor places it in the other cluster, as with Shen_2022 and Donelan_2021.
